title: Corner C3 - Command Palette Design Spec
summary: Cmd+K command palette. Search agents, tasks, switch modes. The power-user shortcut that makes Corner feel like a pro tool.
content:
Corner C3: Command Palette Design Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. Cmd+K is the universal power-user gesture. Every modern tool has one. Corner's should feel like Spotlight meets Linear.

Trigger

  • Keyboard: Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows)
  • Click: Optional trigger button in the HUD bar (magnifying glass icon, far right). Hidden on mobile.
  • Opens centered on screen with a subtle backdrop overlay.

Overlay Design

Backdrop

  • Full viewport overlay
  • Background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
  • Backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
  • Click backdrop to dismiss
  • Esc to dismiss

Modal Container

  • Position: centered, 10vh from top (slightly above center for comfort)
  • Width: 540px (desktop), calc(100vw - 32px) (mobile, with 16px margins)
  • Max-height: 400px
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.98)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)
  • Overflow: hidden

Entrance Animation

  • Backdrop: opacity 0 -> 0.5, 150ms ease
  • Modal: opacity 0 -> 1, scale 0.95 -> 1.0, 200ms ease-out
  • Modal starts slightly above final position: translateY(-8px) -> translateY(0)

Exit Animation

  • Modal: opacity 1 -> 0, scale 1.0 -> 0.97, 150ms ease-in
  • Backdrop: opacity 0.5 -> 0, 150ms ease (simultaneous)

Search Input

Container

  • Height: 52px
  • Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Padding: 0 16px
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 10px

Search Icon

  • Lucide Search, 18px, #6B7280
  • Positioned left of the input

Input Field

  • Flex: 1
  • Background: transparent
  • Border: none
  • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 16px, #FDF6EC
  • Placeholder: "Search agents, tasks, or commands..." in rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)
  • Auto-focus on open
  • Caret color: #E85D26

Shortcut Hint

  • Right side of input row
  • "Esc" in JetBrains Mono 500, 9px, #4A5060
  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)
  • Border-radius: 4px
  • Padding: 2px 6px

Results Area

Container

  • Below the search input
  • Max-height: 348px (400 - 52 input)
  • Overflow-y: auto
  • Padding: 8px 0

Result Groups

Results are grouped by type with section headers:

+--------------------------------------------+
| [Search icon]  Search agents, tasks...  Esc |
+--------------------------------------------+
| AGENTS                                      |
| [Avatar] Bobby - Web Dev         -> Room    |
| [Avatar] Steffen - Brand Design  -> Room    |
|                                             |
| TASKS                                       |
| [Check] Rebuild /v2 to audit...  Bobby      |
| [Check] Fix shared nav footer    Colton     |
|                                             |
| MODES                                       |
| [Icon] Switch to Game            1          |
| [Icon] Switch to Checklist       2          |
| [Icon] Switch to Megaboard       3          |
+--------------------------------------------+

Section Header

  • Font: JetBrains Mono 700, 9px, #4A5060, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em
  • Padding: 8px 16px 4px
  • Not selectable (skip in keyboard navigation)

Result Item

Container:

  • Height: 40px
  • Padding: 0 16px
  • Display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 10px
  • Cursor: pointer
  • Border-radius: 6px (within the 8px padding of results area)
  • Margin: 0 8px (inset from modal edges)

Default State:

  • Background: transparent

Hover / Keyboard-Selected State:

  • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)

Result Item Contents:

  1. Icon/Avatar (left, 24px)

    • Agent results: SpriteAvatar, 24px, agentColor border
    • Task results: Checkbox icon (Lucide CheckSquare), 16px, #6B7280
    • Mode results: Mode icon (Map/ListTodo/LayoutDashboard), 16px, #E85D26
    • Command results: Terminal icon, 16px, #6B7280

  2. Primary Text (flex 1)

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, #F0ECE6
    • Fuzzy search match highlights: matching characters in #E85D26 (bold)
    • Example: searching "bob" shows "Bobby" with "Bob" in orange

  3. Secondary Text (right of primary, or below on mobile)

    • Font: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, #6B7280
    • Agent results: role text
    • Task results: agent name
    • Mode results: none

  4. Keyboard Shortcut Hint (far right)

    • Font: JetBrains Mono 500, 9px, #4A5060
    • Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)
    • Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)
    • Border-radius: 3px
    • Padding: 1px 5px
    • Agent results: number key (1-9 based on roster order)
    • Mode results: 1, 2, or 3
    • Hidden on mobile

Default Results (Empty Query)

When the palette opens with no search text, show:

  1. Recent (last 3 actions)

    • Last 3 agents the user interacted with (chatted or viewed)
    • Label: "RECENT"

  2. Quick Actions

    • "Switch to Game" (key: 1)
    • "Switch to Checklist" (key: 2)
    • "Switch to Megaboard" (key: 3)
    • Label: "MODES"

  3. All Agents (if space)

    • Full agent roster
    • Label: "AGENTS"

Search Behavior

Fuzzy Search

  • Match against: agent names, agent roles, task text, mode names, command names
  • Algorithm: simple substring match is fine for C3 (upgrade to Fuse.js or similar for C4 if result sets grow)
  • Minimum query: 1 character triggers search
  • Results update as the user types (no debounce needed for <20 items)

Result Ordering

  1. Agents matching the query (sorted by roster order)
  2. Tasks matching the query (sorted by most recent activity)
  3. Modes matching the query
  4. Commands matching the query

Maximum Results

  • 10 total visible results. Scroll for more.
  • Groups that have 0 matches are hidden.

Keyboard Navigation

  • Arrow Down / Arrow Up: Move selection between result items (skip section headers)
  • Enter: Execute the selected action
  • Esc: Close the palette
  • Tab: Move to next group's first item (optional, nice-to-have)

Selection indicator: the selected item gets the hover background + a 2px left border in #E85D26.

Actions on Select

Result Type Action
Agent Navigate to agent's room (Game mode) or agent's checklist (Checklist mode). Pan camera if in Game.
Task Navigate to the task's agent's Checklist, scroll to that task.
Mode Switch to that mode.
Command (future) Execute the command.

After executing: palette closes (exit animation).

Mobile Adaptation

  • Full-width modal (16px margins)
  • Search input: 48px height (larger touch target)
  • Result items: 48px height (larger touch target)
  • Keyboard shortcut hints: hidden
  • Section headers: same
  • Backdrop tap dismisses
  • Input auto-focuses, keyboard opens

No gesture to open on mobile (Cmd+K doesn't exist). Access via a search icon button in the HUD bar or a "/search" input in the chat bar.

The command palette is where power users fly. It's the keyboard-driven shortcut layer that makes Corner feel professional, not just playful. Bobby builds this in Step 7.
